goal: Develop an interpretable non-neural edge/boundary detector that surpasses the strongest verified neural-network methods under matched official protocols across multiple diverse benchmarks, while preserving strict development/test separation and generalization.

ultimate_goal.constraint: Final inference must contain no neural network, pretrained neural feature extractor, neural embedding, or neural postprocessor.
ultimate_goal.target: Beat the highest verified neural-network literature metrics on a predeclared multi-benchmark generalization suite under matched official or author-designated protocols.
ultimate_goal.generalization_gate: At least three diverse datasets/protocols, with at least one genuinely untouched external evaluation at the time the frozen generation is selected; no final/test outcome may drive model selection.
ultimate_goal.success_flag: Set goal_reached=true only after the SOTA ledger is freshly verified from primary literature and the frozen non-neural generation satisfies the full multi-benchmark gate.

success_criteria: All architecture selection, feature selection, thresholds, routing rules, and hyperparameters use only development-authorized data: synthetic development sets, UDED selection with leakage-free repeated CV, or a future split explicitly designated as development before target inspection.
The agent may autonomously prune, combine, redesign, promote, and replace classical/fuzzy/non-neural models and methodologies when development evidence and preregistered protocol justify the change.

New mechanisms are evaluated with interpretable ablations or bounded hypothesis-led searches; repeated failures in one mechanism family trigger research into a mechanistically distinct family instead of endless micro-tuning.
A new model generation is frozen only after stable development evidence; inspected UDED held-out, BSDS500 test, and BIPEDv2 test remain unavailable for optimization or experiment prioritization.
Final SOTA claims use official or author-designated evaluators and matched metrics. Incompatible metric/protocol numbers are not compared as if equivalent.
A genuinely untouched external benchmark/protocol is reserved before the final generalization claim.

Every image-based experiment or benchmark report, including development, confirmation, external, and final evaluation, produces deterministic qualitative artifacts including best_method_preview.png from fixed/predeclared examples so model evolution and transfer can be visually inspected without cherry-picking.

development_confirmation_only: UDED held-out (historically inspected; do not optimize on it)
external_test_no_tuning: any future untouched final/external split after inspection
optimization_policy.rule: Never choose or alter hyperparameters, descriptors, thresholds, operator choices, architecture, experiment priority, or routing rules from external/final test outcomes. External results may be documented but are not an optimization signal.

autonomy_policy.normal_mode: Use medium reasoning and the injected persistent scientific context to interpret completed development experiments, update records, and register the next scientifically justified experiment.
autonomy_policy.research_escalation: Use high reasoning plus live web search at research-planning/literature-escalation checkpoints, after contradictions, when no obvious next experiment exists, after repeated stagnation, and before final SOTA verification.
autonomy_policy.fallback: If an experiment fails or Codex has no immediate next experiment but no hard human blocker exists and the ultimate goal is not reached, automatically escalate to a literature/mechanism research checkpoint instead of stopping.
autonomy_policy.stagnation_rule: After three consecutive failed development hypotheses from the same mechanism family, mark that family stagnant and seek a mechanistically different direction before further tuning.
literature_priority: recent preprints when necessary for the current SOTA frontier
autonomy_policy.one_change_rule: Prefer one interpretable mechanism change per falsification iteration; larger bounded searches are allowed after a research checkpoint justifies the mechanism family and preregisters the search space.
autonomy_policy.combination_rule: Prune first. Combine surviving mechanisms when development-only evidence shows complementary errors/regimes or when a preregistered mechanistic rationale justifies an interpretable combination.
autonomy_policy.human_blocker_rule: Routine scientific uncertainty, documentation conflicts with resolvable provenance, failed hypotheses, literature review, ablation design, pruning, and combination design are not human blockers. requires_human=true is reserved for credentials/license acceptance, protected-lineage changes, unsafe/destructive external actions, or irreducible methodological ambiguity that would invalidate a final claim.

visual_reporting.scope: All image-based development, confirmation, external, and final experiments/reports. Historical experiments are not rerun solely to backfill previews unless explicitly requested.
visual_reporting.selection_policy: Use fixed/predeclared representative examples or deterministic manifest positions; do not select examples after seeing which images make a candidate look best.
visual_reporting.preferred_layout: Input, ground truth, incumbent prediction, candidate prediction, and current-best prediction when practical.
visual_reporting.external_rule: External/final previews are documentary qualitative outputs only and must never become an optimization or model-selection signal.
visual_reporting.purpose: Qualitative inspection and evolution tracking only; images must not silently become the optimization signal.

research_families: classical conditioning and denoising that preserves boundaries
non-neural statistical calibration or interpretable routing
non-neural mixture/conditional experts after complementarity evidence
bounded combinations of independently supported mechanisms
next_sequence: continue from the current registered development experiment
register exactly one next falsification or a bounded preregistered search
if direction is unclear, run autonomous literature escalation with high reasoning and live web search
freeze generations only after stable development evidence
periodically refresh the SOTA target ledger
reserve a new untouched final benchmark before declaring generalized SOTA
continue until goal_reached=true or the user explicitly stops, except for hard external blockers
stop_conditions: goal_reached=true after the full generalized non-neural SOTA gate is verified
human STOP file exists or the user terminates the process
a protected scientific-lineage change is scientifically necessary and policy forbids autonomous modification
external credentials, license acceptance, payment, or other user-only action is required
an unsafe/destructive environment action outside the permitted sandbox is required
an irreducible methodological ambiguity would make a final claim invalid and cannot be resolved from code, provenance, literature, or official benchmark documentation
